title: What's New in v2.9.60
notes: 🔔 Feedback & Bug Tracker Alerts in Bell: New submissions and bug reports now automatically trigger alert badges in the top navigation bell icon.
📋 Interactive Preview in Alerts Modal: The Notifications modal now features a dedicated Community Feedback & Bug Reports section with quick previews and one-click access.
🧹 Seamless Auto-Clear: Viewing the Feedback Tracker or marking alerts as read automatically synchronizes and clears the bell badge count.

latestChanges: v2.9.60: Added Community Feedback & Bug Tracker alerts to the notification bell with interactive previews

v2.9.58: Consolidated All-Time Championship Leaderboard under Nav Menu Leaderboards with cross-source deduplication
